description: Human-curated parameter patterns for vLLM Ascend / MindIE on Huawei NPU.

hints.rationale: MoE models benefit from Expert Parallel: without EP, every card holds the same expert shard and MoE layers pay redundant allreduce cost. These flags should be enabled when EP is available.
Deep MoE models (60+ layers) benefit significantly from CUDA Graph. FULL_DECODE_ONLY captures decode-stage graph, avoiding recapture overhead from prefill dynamic shapes.

Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) speculative decoding: num_speculative_tokens=1 can produce negative speedup because verification overhead (~0.5 decode step) exceeds the gain from 1 guessed token. Search values >= 2.
async-scheduling pipelines scheduler dispatch with execution, reducing idle time between batches. Consistent 5-15% throughput improvement.
Long-sequence workloads benefit from larger batch sizes. Increase gradually from baseline, watching for KV cache OOM.
Higher concurrency can improve throughput but increases TTFT linearly. Start conservative, increase in 2x steps per round.

When TPOT is the binding hard constraint, raising api-server-count (multiple API server processes handling requests in parallel) cuts per-request queueing latency — a lever that reduces TPOT WITHOUT sacrificing throughput, unlike lowering CONCURRENCY which trades throughput for latency. If TPOT stalls at a floor while only CONCURRENCY is being tuned, explore this dimension first.

CUDA/ACL Graph capture sizes must cover the actual batch sizes seen at decode time; a batch size beyond the captured range triggers graph miss + recapture per step, inflating TPOT. For short-context workloads keep the range dense (step ~6) from 1 up to the expected max concurrent sequences; for long-context sparser coverage is acceptable. If TPOT is high and capture sizes are left at default, this is a likely contributor.

For short-context workloads (input+output well under the model's max_position_embeddings), do not over-constrain max-model-len to just input+output length — give KV-cache scheduling headroom (a few x the working length). Over-tight max-model-len restricts batch scheduling and can cap throughput, while the true KV-cache footprint is governed by gpu-memory-utilization, not max-model-len.

enforce_eager is a workload-dependent tradeoff, not a universal on/off. false = enable CUDA/ACL Graph capture (helps short-context, decode-dominated, stable-shape workloads — lower TPOT and higher throughput); true = force eager (helps long-context, prefill-dominated, highly dynamic shapes where graph capture sizes cannot cover the batch range and every miss pays recapture). Decide by workload: short in/out + decode-dominated → prefer false; long-context / dynamic shapes → preset's true is correct. Preset scenarios (133k/262k) are long-context, hence their enforce_eager=true.
